_doc: Default runnable example: rigid 200 x 150 x 250 mm box (W x H x D), 80 x 60 mm rect radiator offset (+30, +20) mm from the front-face center, band 50-3000 Hz.
Same geometry as configs/c09_box.json (validation C9) but h comes from the rules: h = min(lambda_min / ppw, D_rad / cells_across_radiator) = 343/3000/20 m (about 5.72 mm).
Box sides are rounded to whole cells (35 x 26 x 44); the radiator position is not snapped.
The loader ignores unknown top-level keys such as this one; unknown keys inside a section are errors.
